case.summary: Case HHG-005 was opened on 2016-12-08 for an online transaction of $100.07 on card C02923-K1, triggered by a bank risk score of 0.54. Evidence showed the transaction amount was well within the card's historical online purchase range, and an independent classifier scored the transaction at 0.01. Although a new iOS device profile was observed, the overall fraud probability was assessed at 0.04. The transaction was deemed legitimate and the case closed, consistent with policy to not block on weak signals.
